## Get Started

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/overview/): We offer a variety of products that make it easy for you to accept payments in your app or website.
- [Payment Methods](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/payment-methods): Integrating with Braintree offers your customers many different ways to pay – and we’re always working on adding more.
- [Try It Out](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/try-it-out): We can't recommend this enough: test early and test often.
- [Transaction Lifecycle](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/transaction-lifecycle): As money travels from the customer to your bank account, the transaction is given a series of statuses. A **successful** transaction will go through the following statuses:
- [Currencies](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/currencies): When it comes to payment processing, we look at currencies in two different contexts: **presentment** and **settlement**.
- [Get Paid](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/get-paid): After a transaction is settled, funds will pass through your merchant account to the bank account you provided during the application process.
- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/data-migration/overview): Your data belongs to you.
- [Explore Braintree](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/explore): Now that we’ve covered the basics, you might be wondering: what’s next? We have a wide variety of features that can make Braintree work for you and your business.
- [Imports](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/data-migration/imports): You must migrate your data into Braintree with no more than two imports: one to import the bulk of your customers, and another to import any new customers created while your…
- [Exports](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/data-migration/exports): You must migrate your data from Braintree with no more than two exports: one to export the bulk of your customers, and another to export any new customers created while your…
- [Braintree Public Key](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/get-started/data-migration/public-key): You'll need to use our public key to encrypt all files when sending us your customer data. Here is any information you may need:
